prompt: You have $5$ test scores from $5$ students. Which display works well?
hint: With only five values, you can afford a display that shows every single score.

hints.text: With only five values, you can afford a display that shows every single score.
A histogram with $1$-point bins would be mostly empty bars, and a pie chart hides the actual scores. Think about the display that places one mark per score on a number line.
A dot plot (choice A) works well for five scores.

explanation: A dot plot puts one dot on a number line for each score, so all $5$ scores can be seen.
A histogram with $1$-point bins would have many empty bins and only a few bars of height $1$.
A pie chart of letter grades would hide the actual scores.
So the dot plot, choice A, is the display that works well.
